name: @facemorph/web
description: The FaceMorph web app: the candidate's imported JS closure (fm-gpx, byte-identical under src/, desktop/, photo-runtime/, scripts/ ...) and the Vite + React shell it is ported into (fm-svg). bulma, bulma-prefers-dark and react-advanced-cropper are what the closure's style.scss imports, at classic's locked versions.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json && tsc -p src/project/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: node --test test/build/*.test.ts test/contracts/*.test.ts test/media/*.test.ts test/admission/*.test.ts test/project/*.test.ts
